text: This animal has 9 brains, 3 hearts, and blue blood.
The octopus has around 500 million neurons, about as many as a dog.
But two thirds of them aren't in its head.
Each arm has its own mini brain.
It can taste, touch and move on its own.
But the main brain can still step in and take control.
3 hearts: two pump blood past the gills, one pumps it around the body.
But when it swims, that body heart goes quiet.
And the blood is blue, because it carries oxygen with copper, not iron.
But in cold water with little oxygen, copper actually works better.
